model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven evaluation criteria, with categories listed along the vertical axis and participant counts along the horizontal axis ranging from 0 to 6. The longest bar corresponds to “Relevant FCs,” selected by 6 participants, followed by “FC Summary” at 5 participants. “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” are tied at 3 participants each, while “Overall Summary” was chosen by 2 participants. The shortest bars, both at 1 participant, represent “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation.” Each bar is color-coded uniquely—ranging from dark purple for “Relevant FCs” to light green for “Veracity Explanation”—and labeled with its exact participant count at the end of the bar. The chart is sorted in descending order of participant count, visually emphasizing the most frequently selected criteria at the top.
